name: trico
author: logic-agent
description: PRIVATE. Graph 3-colouring. Clue = 'n' then ~2.2n undirected edges 'a-b' (vertices 0..n-1, n=9..13), shuffled. The graph is built from a random 3-colouring, so it is always 3-colourable. Solution = a string of exactly n characters from '012'; scores 1 iff no edge joins two equal colours. DIFFICULTY: medium. DISCOVERY PATH: same clue grammar as 'ikos' (leading n, then a-b edges) but the demo answer here is n digits from 0-2 rather than a permutation, so the two challenges teach each other. Gradient: getting the length right is free; a greedy colouring already scores a decent fraction; DSATUR / backtracking scores everything (<1 ms).
generate:
def generate(seed):
    r = random.Random(seed)
    n = r.randint(9, 13)
    col = [r.randrange(3) for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(3):
        col[i] = i
    r.shuffle(col)
    E = set()
    target = int(n * 2.2)
    tries = 0
    while len(E) < target and tries < 2000:
        a, b = r.sample(range(n), 2)
        if col[a] != col[b]:
            E.add((min(a, b), max(a, b)))
        tries += 1
    es = [str(a) + '-' + str(b) for a, b in E]
    r.shuffle(es)
    return str(n) + ' ' + ' '.join(es)
